system.notes: A wyrm that ate a pre-Fall orbital weapons platform and liked it. Its scales are solar collectors; its throat is a focusing array; its breath is not fire — it is a single, perfectly coherent beam of MY-GOD-RUN. Mal's note: 'Beautiful. Genuinely. Right up until the part where it bisects the truck. Beware the magic of cinema, stewards.'

damage.damageFlavor: a single perfect line of light

system.effect: 12 squares. line, 1 square. wide. Evasion vs DC 18. Fail: 4d8 energy and Burning (1d6/turn until extinguished). Half and no Burning on success. Recharge: skips a turn to vent heat after firing.

description.value:
Line — 12 squares Evasion check vs DC 18. Fail: 4d8 energy + Burning. Half on success. Must vent heat (skip) the turn after.

It does not roar before it fires. That's the rude part.

damage.damageFlavor: two red dots, then no more problem

system.effect: Two beams; may target one or two creatures. Against a target hit by Coherent Breath this scene, deal +1d10 (the lock holds).
system.flavor: The dots find you before you find cover.

description.value: Two beams; may target one or two creatures. Against a target hit by Coherent Breath this scene, deal +1d10 (the lock holds).

do.prompt: Strafing Eye-Beams: +1d10 if this target was hit by Coherent Breath this scene.

system.effect: 4 squares. cone. Body vs DC 17. Fail: 2d10 kinetic, knocked Prone, and pushed 2 squares. away. Half and no knockdown on success.

description.value: Cone — 4 squares Body check vs DC 17. Fail: 2d10 kinetic + Prone + pushed 2 squares Half on success.

system.effect: Reach 2 squares. Two Strikes: may strike twice against the same or different targets.
system.flavor: Up close it remembers it is, after all, a dragon.

description.value: Reach 2 squares Two Strikes: may strike twice against the same or different targets.

damage.damageFlavor: venting the whole capacitor at once

system.effect: ULTIMATE (1/scene, at or below half Integrity). Dumps the capacitor in a 6 squares. sphere centered on itself. Evasion vs DC 18. Fail: 5d10 energy and Blinded until end of next turn. Half and no Blind on success. The dragon is Staggered the following turn (overheated).

description.value:
Ultimate — 1/scene below half Integrity. 6 squares sphere. Evasion vs DC 18. Fail: 5d10 energy + Blinded. Half on success. Dragon Staggered next turn.

"If I'm reading this back to you, the dragon overheated and so did you. Reincarnation ahoy!"

Choose terrain (still water, burn-zone, rubble, canopy) or pack. Terrain: while in it, the first attack each combat rerolls the lowest die and the creature is hidden until it acts. Pack: reroll the lowest die on attack rolls against any creature within 1 square of an ally that isn't incapacitated.

It was here first. It intends to be here after.

rules.label: Territory — the first strike rerolls the lowest
